content.short: Etherspot provides account abstraction infrastructure, smart wallet tooling, and developer SDKs for building smoother Mantle apps.
content.description: Etherspot is a developer platform focused on account abstraction and chain abstraction for EVM applications. Its official materials highlight ERC-4337 infrastructure, smart account SDKs, paymasters, bundlers, transaction tooling, and onboarding features such as gasless flows or social-style user experiences. Rather than acting as a consumer wallet, Etherspot serves teams building wallets, games, and dApps that want to remove friction from signing and transaction execution. On Mantle, it fits as smart wallet infrastructure for builders who want better UX without giving up self-custody or programmable controls.
